newsitem.title: GREECE: NATL BANK GREECE CUTS DEPO, LOAN RATES.
newsitem.headline: NATL BANK GREECE CUTS DEPO, LOAN RATES.

text.p: National Bank of Greece will cut its base lending and deposit rates effective Monday April 7, following a better-than-expected CPI inflation drop to 6.0 percent year-on-year in March.
National Bank dropped its base loan rate for working capital by 50 basis points to 15.0 percent.
Its base lending rate for fixed assets was cut by 75 basis points down to 13.0 percent.
Floating rate mortgages were cut 100 basis points to 13.0 percent.
Consumer loan rates were also cut by 100 basis points as follows:
** Credit card rate at 23.75 from 24.75 percent
** Auto loans through dealer at 17.5 from 18.5 percent
** Home appliance Ethno-loan at 17.5 from 18.5 percent
The above consumer loan rates include a 1.0 percent surcharge based on law 128/75, it said.
National Bank savings deposit rates were also cut by 50 basis points down to 9.0 percent, it said.
